observation.command:
cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt
# Step 1: hit app, get redirect to Keycloak
AUTH_URL=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' http://localhost:3000/app/)
echo "auth url: ${AUTH_URL:0:120}..."
# Step 2: GET auth page, save cookies + csrf
curl -s -c cj.txt -o kc.html "$AUTH_URL"
echo "csrf:"; grep -oE 'name="csrf" value="[^"]+"' kc.html | head -1
echo "login form action:"; grep -oE '<form[^>]*id="kc-login"[^>]*' kc.html | head -1
grep -oE 'action="[^"]+"' kc.html | head -3
